packageRules.description: changesets/action's major is the v1/v2 line boundary, not a dependency bump. Moving it is a deliberate release decision made alongside the consumers' @changesets/cli major. See README 'Why there are two lines'.
Action bumps merge themselves once CI is green. This replaces the org Mergify rule removed in #57; unlike that rule, `matchUpdateTypes` actually excludes majors.
Majors reach every consumer pinned to a moving major alias the moment they land, so they stay a human decision.
